pages.title: Magnetars
pages.text: $(thing)Magnetars$()$(br2)A star's core collapses to a neutron star and its field is squeezed with it, flux conserved: a thousand times stronger than any magnet made on Earth, a billion times. Starquakes crack its crust.

$(thing)Insight$(): 160$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Magnetic Confinement, Compact Stars.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Magnetar Crust Fragment, 2 Pulsar Timing Crystal.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A core of radius R threaded by a field B collapses to radius r, keeping all the field lines through it. Write the field b it ends with.
